response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, cnt, cnt * 100.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The average share across statuses is the unweighted mean of each status group's share, and the NULL status counts as one group in that mean. Since shares sum to 100, this equals 100 divided by the number of groups.
Only NULL powerstatus counts as missing. Empty-string statuses, if any, remain separate groups.
